title: Grain cart
description: Hopper grain cart on two lugged wheels: sloped open-top hopper with a yellow lip and band, a scalable grain heap inside, chassis rails, mudguards, an A-frame tongue to the hitch eye at the front and a tow clevis at the back. Material `paint` is repainted per player.
checks: LEFT tile: a hopper wider at the top than the bottom, on one axle of big wheels that touch the grid line, a tongue reaching forward to the front end
3/4 tile: the hopper is open on top and holds a golden grain mound below the yellow lip
BACK tile: the hopper sides slope out (a V/trapezoid), mudguards over both wheels, a tow clevis in the middle at the bottom
TOP tile: the tongue is an A-frame meeting at a single hitch eye on the centre line
